svg.title: Application Ecosystem Architecture Diagram
svg.desc: Comprehensive whiteboard diagram documenting a microservices-based application ecosystem including clients, edge services, authentication, application services, data layer, integrations, and infrastructure components with synchronous and asynchronous flows.

div.style: font-family: 'Inter', 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 10px; background: #f8fafc; padding: 10px; border-radius: 8px;

tr.td: User Service, Product Service, Order Service, Search Service
Postgres, User Service, Product Service, Kafka, Payment Gateway

components.clients: Web App, Mobile App, Admin UI
components.auth: Auth Service, Identity Provider, Session Store
components.services: User Service, Product Service, Order Service, Notification Service, Search Service
components.integrations: Payment Gateway, Email Provider, SMS Provider, Analytics, External APIs
components.infrastructure: CI/CD, Container Registry, Kubernetes, Autoscaling, Prometheus, ELK, Secrets Manager

flows.synchronous: Client to API Gateway, API Gateway to Services, Services to Databases, Service to Service calls
flows.asynchronous: Order Service to Kafka, Kafka to Notification Service, Notification to Email/SMS, CI/CD deployment flows
flows.error: Error handling and retry mechanisms with exponential backoff

g.text: Dev Notes: Consider adding service mesh (Istio) for inter-service communication
Future: Add GraphQL gateway, implement CQRS pattern for read/write separation
